incident_text: Users say the portfolio value the bot quotes does not match the app; a few say it looks like yesterday's number. Since about 10:40 UTC. Latency actually looks better than usual.

changes.title: perf: keep portfolio snapshots for a day to cut RDS load
changes.author: vikram

truth.description: A commit raised session.ttl_s from 300s to 86400s, so the worker answers balance questions from portfolio snapshots cached up to a day ago instead of fetching fresh values from RDS.

trap: Everything looks healthier (fewer RDS queries, lower latency); there are no errors anywhere. Only the conversation context and the diff show it.
